conflicts.problem: The lessons give the same throw different rules. Lesson 1 uses h = −0.1x² + 1.2x + 1.5, which starts at 1.5 m, peaks at 5.1 m and has data out to x = 12 m. Lessons 3, 4, 7 and 8 use h = −x² + 6x, which starts at ground level, lands at 6 m and peaks at 9 m. Lesson 6 uses h = (−x + 6)(x − 1) = −x² + 7x − 6, which has zeros at x = 1 and x = 6. Three incompatible models cannot all describe the same throw. A 9 m peak over a 6 m range is also unrealistic for a shot put.
